title: Boot to the title screen (zero input)
notes: Five shots across the title window, not one: gGameMode never leaves GAMEMODE_TITLE between
the boot logo and the attract-mode demo race, so there is no WAITMODE gate to use, and the
poll index at which the art appears moves run to run (the boot timeline is wall-clock-coupled;
the 59.94 Hz frame pacer does not fix it). Pick the frame that is on the title and say so.
The 4:3/16:9 caveat: gEnhancements.Graphics.Widescreen defaults to 1 and is NEVER registered
on the 3DS (port/3ds/game/CMakeLists.txt excludes gdx_menu*.cpp, and the CVar stub returns the
caller's default), so the console renders hor+ -- confirmed by the [wide] receipt lines in a
console run's log. refrun.py's floor sets it to 0; the manifest records which was used.
